dedupe_keys.name: fault pattern dataset for a 33 kv power distribution network

description: Fault Pattern Dataset for a 33 kV Power Distribution Network is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Akinwale Stephen Akintaro, Sayed Mohsin Reza (Penn State Harrisburg). This dataset contains historical fault records collected from a 33 kV power distribution network situated within the 104101–104291 zip code region of Lagos State, in the southwest of Nigeria (representing an area characterized by rapid residential and industrial growth) over a 7.58-year period (April 2017 to December 2024). Coverage: national (NG); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
